invariants: ActorKind has exactly the 6 frozen values of work_events.py ACTOR_KINDS; Cause has exactly the 14 values of the per-kind frozen sets (4 reconcile + 4 cancel + 6 failure, with budget_exhausted shared).

allowed_for is the ONLY cause validation: NeedsReconcile takes {LeaseLost, DeadlineExceeded, ScopeStopped, Interrupted}; Cancelled and CancelRequested take {OperatorRequest, WorkflowCancelled, BudgetExhausted, Superseded}; Failed takes the six failure causes; every other kind takes NO cause (allowed_for returns false for any cause).
Actor is a plain value: kind + id; constructing one never validates against a registry.
responsibilities: ActorKind and Actor: who acted, from the frozen 6-value vocabulary, with as_str/parse round-trip.
Cause: the union of the per-kind frozen cause sets as one enum, with as_str/parse round-trip.
Cause::allowed_for(kind): the per-kind set membership check producers must pass before emitting an event.
summary: The frozen actor/cause vocabulary of work_events.py as types: who acted, and which causes each negative event kind may carry.
